targets.notes: Native launch and the read-only core are verified independently, but the system directory dialog through a real external-volume scan was not automated or manually completed in this run.
Representative token pairs pass their role thresholds and axe reports zero violations on landing and results states.

The current Phase 1 bundle launched, but this environment could not enumerate its native window for a fresh isolated capture. The archived M0 native screenshot is intentionally excluded from current visual proof.
Code review found no WebView path authority and no network, move, rename, timestamp, or delete command. UI text discloses possible filesystem-managed atime updates.

The production React frontend passed the 1024x768 browser boundary, but this required target needs a current native WebView capture and remains unavailable. Browser evidence is mapped to the optional inspection target.
Semantic and axe checks passed, but VoiceOver reading order, live status announcements, and the native directory dialog were not manually evaluated.
The original Guiying photo-and-check icon is present in the deterministic source and packaged 512px/32px assets; both were decoded and inspected.
A keyboard-only Playwright test reaches the explicitly labelled synthetic scan and results; focus indicators and focus restoration are covered.

The Rust/Tauri bundle and the final frontend production build passed separately, but the bundle predates the last frontend-only result queue hardening and was deleted during build-artifact cleanup. It is not claimed as an exact final-tree integrated artifact.

The bundled process launched and exited cleanly, but the current window could not be enumerated; the native runtime target remains unavailable rather than promoting process-only evidence to a visual run.

The production React frontend passed the 1280x820 browser boundary, but this required target needs a current native WebView capture and remains unavailable. Browser evidence is mapped to the optional inspection target.

Current landing, scanning, compact/large results, paged-result, historical-catalog and expanded raw-metadata browser captures were reviewed at original size. The packaged icon has its own asset report.
The direction contract maps signature evidence grammar, components, states, layout, accessibility, anti-goals, and repository ownership.

limitations.impact: The evidence does not prove a complete macOS directory-dialog to real external-volume scan through the Tauri IPC bridge.
limitations.mitigation: Run the P0 external-volume matrix on disposable APFS and exFAT fixtures, exercise dialog selection and interruption cases, and attach the native run recording before changing this target to passed.

limitations.impact: The Tauri shell/Rust bundle and final frontend passed independently, but no retained .app/.dmg was built from the exact final frontend queue revision after generated artifacts were cleaned.
limitations.mitigation: Let CI build the exact pushed tree, or run one clean Tauri bundle build on a runner with an explicit artifact-space budget and attach that result before promoting this target.
